description.content: Manage contacts (website visitors identified by name, email, or phone)
Returns a paginated list of contacts. Contacts are website visitors who have interacted with the Tidio widget and have been identified by their name, email address, or phone number.

REST API for managing contacts, conversations, tickets, operators, and Lyro AI data sources. Requires Plus or Premium plan for full access; Lyro AI plan grants access to Lyro-specific endpoints. Authentication uses paired X-Tidio-Openapi-Client-Id and X-Tidio-Openapi-Client-Secret headers. Rate limits range from 10 requests per minute (entry plans) to 120 requests per minute (Premium).
